{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
duplicate_count = len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch B values in biomarker_final
print(f"Number of rows with assay_batch == 'B': {(df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()}")
print(f"Sample of biomarker_final values for assay_batch == 'B': {df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'].head(5).values}")

# Check the distribution of arm and severity
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
